template: pre-2024 small template (Oct-Sep axis; coloured boxes: gold harvest, dark red lean, blue rainy, green land prep/planting)

regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (no regional blocks or locator map)

harvest.name: Minor harvest - sweet potatoes, maize & millet

regions.notes: Axis runs OCT to SEP. Rainy season drawn as Oct + Apr-Sep, merged. Rice harvest drawn as Aug-Sep + Oct to early Jan, merged. Only land preparation bars (rice Jan-Apr; minor harvest Feb-Mar) are shown, so planting is empty.

assign.method: Single-region calendar: every province mapped to national.

transcriber_notes: Old small template: 13 labels (OCT ... SEP, OCT) on the 13 dashed month-boundary lines, so the first column is OCT; the APR, JUN and JUL lines are hidden behind boxes and were interpolated. Rice harvest box ends about 40% into Jan (Jan not counted). Lean box starts about half-way through May (cover ~0.48, counted). Labels "Cash crop maketing" and "Lifestock disease and pests" are misspelt on the image (not used).
